definitions.explanation: tending to talk a lot or use many words

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多弁|たべん}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。

examples.english: I become talkative when I drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧⟦{無口|むくち}→無口：06644_mukuchi⟧な⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多弁|たべん}だ。
examples.english: He's usually quiet, but he's talkative today.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{多|た} (many) + {弁|べん} (speech)

USAGE:
Can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context. Unlike ⟦お{喋|しゃべ}り→お喋り：01911_oshaberi⟧, which is casual and often affectionate, {多弁|たべん} is more formal and can imply excessive talking.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {多弁|たべん} (talkative) ↔ ⟦{寡黙|かもく}→寡黙：12355_kamoku⟧ (taciturn)
- {多弁|たべん} ↔ ⟦{無口|むくち}→無口：06644_mukuchi⟧ (quiet, untalkative)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{雄弁|ゆうべん}→雄弁：14579_yuuben⟧ - eloquent
- ⟦{能弁|のうべん}→能弁：18101_nouben⟧ - fluent, articulate
- ⟦{饒舌|じょうぜつ}→饒舌：08651_jouzetsu⟧ - garrulous, verbose
- ⟦お{喋|しゃべ}り→お喋り：01911_oshaberi⟧ - chatty (casual)
